title: cotula sericea var. discolor
intro: Cotula sericea var. discolor, commonly known as Woolly Bunchflower, is a perennial herb that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cotula sericea var. discolor include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
